novelty_disc.analysis: 未被质疑：审查材料中未见基于EPC Article 54的新颖性异议。早期检索意见主要依据Article 52(2)(3)和Article 56提出非技术性及创造性问题，2020年和2021年审查意见亦集中于D2、通用计算机、OLAP及COMVIK式创造性评价。最终作出授权决定，说明授权文本中不存在未克服的新颖性障碍。

Decision to grant a European patent pursuant to Article 97(1) EPC
Following examination of European patent application No.10007106.7 a European patent ... is hereby granted in respect of the designated Contracting States.
novelty_disc.translation: 根据EPC第97(1)条授予欧洲专利的决定。经对欧洲专利申请No.10007106.7进行审查，现就指定缔约国授予欧洲专利。
novelty_disc.llm_evidence_explanation: 该原文为最终授权决定，结合审查材料中没有出现Article 54或novelty objection，可支持新颖性未被质疑并最终通过审查，因此评分为100。

inventive_step_disc.analysis: 创造性曾被明确质疑，但最终通过授权文本克服。按EPO problem-solution approach及COMVIK逻辑，审查员将最接近现有技术确定为通用网络计算机/已知OLAP多维数据存储，D2用于证明OLAP及多维访问、速度响应等属于已知背景。区别特征被审查员归为运行在该计算机上的业务/预测建模方法，包括变量确定、假设确定、模型生成、模型评价、元数据层和数据层中的业务关系及聚合规则等。审查员认为这些区别特征不产生可从权利要求导出的技术效果，不能形成客观技术问题；技术效果“query engine faster”和“multidimensional querying faster”未能从权利要求中导出，若可导出则D2已涉及类似问题。最终授权说明申请人后续通过修改或说服性意见使Article 56障碍得以克服，但因创造性曾是核心风险，评分为80。
inventive_step_disc.original_text:
The closest prior art is therefore considered to be a general purpose computer from which the subject-matter of claim 1 differs through the business method running on that computer system.
Features which cannot be seen to make any contribution, either independently or in combination with other features, to the solution of a technical problem are not relevant for assessing inventive step. The business method described above is therefore not relevant for assessing inventive step.
The person skilled in the art of data processing would consider the implementation of non-technical methods in a computer system to be part of his daily work and therefore would consider it obvious to attempt to implement the business method above in a general purpose networked computer system when presented with the method, for example, in the form of a requirements specification requesting the automation of the method.
The presented alleged technical effects in paragraph [ooo4] "through the use of a meta data layer and a data layer according to the resent application, query ... engine is made much faster and multidimensional querying is also made much faster" are not derivable from the claims. D2 mentions a similar problem, so if this problem is derivable from the claim, the solution would be known from D2.
For the reasons given above, the examiner is unable to derive any technical problem from the claimed subject-matter. Indeed, the skilled person would translate the non-technical method into a general purpose computer through use of standard data processing techniques as part of his normal daily work without encountering any technical problem. He would therefore arrive at the subject-matter of claim 1 without making an inventive step (Article 56 EPC).
inventive_step_disc.translation: 因此，最接近的现有技术被认为是通用计算机，权利要求1的主题与其区别在于运行在该计算机系统上的商业方法。不能被认为单独或组合地对解决技术问题作出贡献的特征，与创造性评价无关。因此，上述商业方法与创造性评价无关。数据处理领域的技术人员会认为将非技术方法实现在计算机系统中属于其日常工作的一部分，因此当以例如要求自动化该方法的需求说明书形式给出该方法时，会认为尝试在通用网络计算机系统中实现上述商业方法是显而易见的。申请人在第[0004]段提出的所谓技术效果，即通过使用元数据层和数据层使查询引擎更快、多维查询也更快，不能从权利要求中导出。D2提到了类似问题，因此如果该问题能从权利要求中导出，其解决方案也会由D2知晓。基于上述理由，审查员不能从权利要求主题中导出任何技术问题。事实上，技术人员会使用标准数据处理技术，将非技术方法转化到通用计算机中，作为其正常日常工作的一部分，且不会遇到任何技术问题。因此，其无需创造性劳动即可得到权利要求1的主题。
inventive_step_disc.llm_evidence_explanation: 该段原文直接给出最接近现有技术、区别特征、非技术特征排除、技术效果不可导出以及Article 56显而易见性结论，构成本案创造性核心风险证据；但最终授权决定显示该异议已被克服，故不评为低分而评为80。

support_disc.analysis: 未被质疑：审查材料中未见基于EPC Article 83、Article 84支持性或Article 123(2)新增内容的独立拒绝理由。虽然审查员曾称申请中缺少实现数据存储的技术细节，但该论述被用于Article 56/COMVIK框架下说明技术贡献不足，而非充分公开或说明书支持不足。最终授权决定表明授权文本满足EPC形式及实质授权要求。

clarity_disc.analysis: 未被质疑：审查材料中未见基于EPC Article 84的清楚性异议。2020年和2021年意见虽指出若干模块“not defined in technical terms”，但语境是将这些特征归为非技术业务特征并用于创造性评价，并非提出权利要求不清楚的Article 84拒绝。最终授权决定说明授权文本不存在未解决的清楚性障碍。
clarity_disc.original_text:
The variable determination, the assumption, the model generator and the model evaluation module are not defined in technical terms. This could be humans having a task to perform. To implement the functionality of this modules in a computer environment is regarded as straightforward.

Decision to grant a European patent pursuant to Article 97(1) EPC
Following examination of European patent application No.10007106.7 a European patent ... is hereby granted in respect of the designated Contracting States.
clarity_disc.translation: 变量确定、假设、模型生成器和模型评价模块并未以技术术语定义。这些可以是执行任务的人。将这些模块的功能实现在计算机环境中被认为是直接的。根据EPC第97(1)条授予欧洲专利的决定：经对欧洲专利申请No.10007106.7进行审查，现就指定缔约国授予欧洲专利。
clarity_disc.llm_evidence_explanation: 该原文可能表面涉及模块定义，但上下文用于非技术性和创造性分析，并未引用Article 84；最终授权进一步支持清楚性问题未被正式质疑或已不存在，故评分100。

eligibility_disc.analysis: 适格性曾被质疑但最终通过。2010年检索意见认为权利要求1-15涉及EPC Article 52(2)(3)排除的主题活动；2020年和2021年意见进一步认为方法本身是抽象思想，缺乏技术考虑，若单独看落入排除范围。但同时审查材料承认上诉委员会认为数据存储系统具有技术性，权利要求的技术性来自由具有多维存储的通用网络计算机执行数据处理步骤。EP标准下，只要权利要求整体具有技术手段通常可越过Article 52门槛；非技术特征主要在COMVIK创造性分析中不贡献技术效果。最终授权说明适格性障碍已被克服，因此评分80。
eligibility_disc.original_text:
The subject matter of claims 1-15 is considered to relate to subject matter excluded ... under Art. 52(2) and (3) EPC.

The method defines an abstract idea and is devoid of any technical consideration and therefore, when considered on its own, falls under the list of exclusions from patentability under Article 52(2) and (3) EPC.
The technical character of the claim resides in that the data processing steps necessary for the determination of a final model operable to be used to forecast information for an objective are executed by general purpose networked computer having a multidimensional storage.

The Board of Appeal finds the data storage system as technical.
eligibility_disc.translation: 权利要求1-15的主题被认为涉及EPC第52(2)和(3)条所排除的主题。该方法定义了一个抽象思想，并且缺乏任何技术考虑，因此当单独考虑时，落入EPC第52(2)和(3)条规定的可专利性排除清单。该权利要求的技术性在于，用于确定可用于预测目标信息的最终模型所必需的数据处理步骤，由具有多维存储的通用网络计算机执行。上诉委员会认为数据存储系统具有技术性。
eligibility_disc.llm_evidence_explanation: 该原文同时显示Article 52适格性异议和技术性承认。按照EPO实践，技术手段使整体具备技术性，非技术内容转入Article 56/COMVIK评价；最终授权表明适格性异议已解决，故评分80。

recommended_actions.original_text: Prepare an element-by-element comparison with D2, identifying technical limitations in the granted claims that D2 does not disclose or suggest.

recommended_actions.original_text: Add internal technical evidence quantifying how the metadata layer and data layer affect query speed, storage footprint, or processing efficiency for later invalidity or opposition defense.

examination_material_evidence.original_text: The presented alleged technical effects in paragraph [ooo4] "through the use of a meta data layer and a data layer according to the resent application, query ... engine is made much faster and multidimensional querying is also made much faster" are not derivable from the claims. D2 mentions a similar problem, so if this problem is derivable from the claim, the solution would be known from D2.
examination_material_evidence.translation: 申请人在第[0004]段提出的所谓技术效果，即通过使用本申请的元数据层和数据层，使查询引擎更快、多维查询也更快，不能从权利要求中导出。D2提到了类似问题，因此如果该问题能从权利要求中导出，其解决方案将由D2知晓。
examination_material_evidence.llm_evidence_explanation: 该证据直接否定了申请人用于支持创造性的技术效果，是创造性风险的关键依据。

examination_material_evidence.original_text: For the reasons given above, the examiner is unable to derive any technical problem from the claimed subject-matter. Indeed, the skilled person would translate the non-technical method into a general purpose computer through use of standard data processing techniques as part of his normal daily work without encountering any technical problem. He would therefore arrive at the subject-matter of claim 1 without making an inventive step (Article 56 EPC).
examination_material_evidence.translation: 基于上述理由，审查员无法从权利要求主题中导出任何技术问题。事实上，技术人员会使用标准数据处理技术将非技术方法转化到通用计算机中，作为其正常日常工作的一部分，且不会遇到任何技术问题。因此，其无需创造性劳动即可得到权利要求1的主题。
examination_material_evidence.llm_evidence_explanation: 该证据明确给出Article 56否定结论，并体现COMVIK逻辑下非技术方法自动化通常显而易见。

examination_material_evidence.original_text:
The examination is being carried out on the following application documents
Description, Pages 4-26 as originally filed
1-3 filed in electronic form on 21-09-2020
Claims, Numbers 1-10 received on 13-05-2015 with letter of 13-05-2015
Drawings, Sheets 1/8-8/8 as originally filed
examination_material_evidence.translation: 审查基于以下申请文件进行：说明书第4-26页为原始提交文本；第1-3页为2020年9月21日以电子形式提交；权利要求第1-10项为随2015年5月13日信函于2015年5月13日提交；附图第1/8-8/8页为原始提交文本。
examination_material_evidence.llm_evidence_explanation: 该证据显示文件基础明确，材料中未出现Art.83或Art.123(2)拒绝，支持充分公开/支持维度未被质疑。

examination_material_evidence.original_text: The variable determination, the assumption, the model generator and the model evaluation module are not defined in technical terms. This could be humans having a task to perform. To implement the functionality of this modules in a computer environment is regarded as straightforward.
examination_material_evidence.translation: 变量确定、假设、模型生成器和模型评价模块并未以技术术语定义。这些可以是执行任务的人。将这些模块的功能实现在计算机环境中被认为是直接的。
examination_material_evidence.llm_evidence_explanation: 该段虽提到模块未以技术术语定义，但并非Article 84清楚性拒绝，而是用于将特征归入非技术内容并进行创造性分析。

examination_material_evidence.original_text:
The subject matter of claims 1-15 is considered to relate to subject matter excluded ... under Art. 52(2) and (3) EPC.
The examiner cannot determine any technical solution defined in response to a technical problem within the content of the application as filed.
examination_material_evidence.translation: 权利要求1-15的主题被认为涉及EPC第52(2)和(3)条所排除的主题。审查员无法在原始提交的申请内容中确定针对技术问题所定义的任何技术解决方案。
examination_material_evidence.llm_evidence_explanation: 该证据显示本案早期存在适格性/技术性重大异议。

examination_material_evidence.original_text:
The method defines an abstract idea and is devoid of any technical consideration and therefore, when considered on its own, falls under the list of exclusions from patentability under Article 52(2) and (3) EPC.
The technical character of the claim resides in that the data processing steps necessary for the determination of a final model operable to be used to forecast information for an objective are executed by general purpose networked computer having a multidimensional storage.
examination_material_evidence.translation: 该方法定义了一个抽象思想，并且缺乏任何技术考虑，因此当单独考虑时，落入EPC第52(2)和(3)条规定的可专利性排除清单。该权利要求的技术性在于，用于确定可用于预测目标信息的最终模型所必需的数据处理步骤，由具有多维存储的通用网络计算机执行。
examination_material_evidence.llm_evidence_explanation: 该证据同时说明排除性风险与权利要求存在技术手段，是适格性评分为80而非100的原因。
